# Utah Valley University

> Utah Valley University is a comprehensive public institution offering undergraduate and graduate programs across engineering, health, humanities, and science with a focus on accessible, engaged learning and student success.

UVU serves students through multiple pathways including traditional on-campus programs, online education, concurrent enrollment partnerships with high schools, and specialized support services for first-generation, military-affiliated, and international students. The university emphasizes community engagement, student wellness, and career preparation.

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [Admissions & Application](https://www.uvu.edu/admissions): Admissions process and application portal for domestic, international, and transfer students.
- [Financial Aid & Scholarships](https://www.uvu.edu/financialaid): Financial aid, scholarships, FAFSA information, and funding opportunities.
- [Tuition](https://www.uvu.edu/tuition): Tuition costs, student fees, and payment procedures for all student types.
- [Concurrent Enrollment](https://www.uvu.edu/concurrent): High school partnership program enabling students to earn college credit.

## Academic Programs

- [Academics](https://www.uvu.edu/academics): Academic programs across colleges including engineering, health, humanities, and science.
- [Online Education](https://www.uvu.edu/online): Online degree programs including bachelor's and master's degrees with flexible scheduling.
- [Honors Program](https://www.uvu.edu/honors): Honors program curriculum, admissions, and academic advising for high-achieving students.
- [Schedule](https://www.uvu.edu/schedule): Academic calendar, course schedules, and student dates and deadlines.

## Student Life & Services

- [Student Life](https://www.uvu.edu/studentlife): Student services, housing, recreation, wellness, and engagement opportunities.
- [Campus Life](https://www.uvu.edu/campus-life): Overview of campus life, student clubs, events, and community engagement opportunities.
- [Housing](https://www.uvu.edu/housing): Student housing options, residential life, and housing search resources.

## About & Community

- [About UVU](https://www.uvu.edu/about): University overview, institutional facts, leadership, and mission information.
- [Homepage](https://www.uvu.edu): UVU homepage showcasing student success through engaged learning and accessible higher education.
- [Alumni](https://www.uvu.edu/alumni): Alumni relations, community engagement, and networking opportunities for graduates.
- [News](https://www.uvu.edu/news): News hub featuring university stories, announcements, and campus community updates.

## Support & Resources

- [Give](https://www.uvu.edu/give): Donation and fundraising platform supporting scholarships, resources, and student programs.
- [Visitors and Community](https://www.uvu.edu/visitors): Campus visit information, tours, parking, facilities, and visitor resources.
